name: Smokehouse BBQ & Bar
description: A sit-down barbecue restaurant and bar in Adventure Point, with takeaway too. The meats are smoked for 12 hours, including pulled pork, beef brisket and ribs, and there is a Taste of Texas sharing platter. The park is cashless, so bring a card. Prices come from an undated menu and may have changed.

items.name: Pulled Pork Brioche
items.description: 12-hour smoked pulled pork in a brioche bun

name: The Vampire Burger Kitchen
description: A burger restaurant in Wild Woods on the way to Vampire, with self-service kiosks and eat-in or takeaway. It serves beef, chicken and plant-based burgers, plus fries, desserts and kids' meals. Prices here are estimates.

name: Pizza Pasta
description: An all-you-can-eat sit-down buffet in Adventure Point with pizza (pepperoni, margherita, vegetarian and vegan), garlic bread, fresh pasta, a salad bar and free-refill soft drinks. Prices here are estimates.

items.name: Pizza & Pasta Buffet
items.description: All-you-can-eat pizza, pasta and salad bar

name: Zafari Bar & Grill
description: An African-themed restaurant and bar inside the Chessington Safari Hotel, with views over the Wanyama Reserve. It is a hotel restaurant outside the park gates and serves breakfast and dinner with grill dishes, salads, vegan options and a kids' menu. Prices here are estimates.
